name: 49847-specdecode-120bmoe-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole node, all eight GPUs.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: 120B hybrid MoE decoder, 12B active (`NemotronHForCausalLM`): 40 Mamba2, 40 MoE and 8 attention layers, FP8 per-tensor static weights. The multi-token-prediction drafter ships inside the same checkpoint, so no second model is downloaded. 26 safetensors shards, 128.3 GB, ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 49847. `--max-num-seqs 256` matches the stream count.
workload: REAL GSM8K test questions -- `openai/gsm8k`, config `main`, split `test`, the `question` column, 1319 rows, cycled by the loader to fill the batch. Greedy (temperature 0), `max_tokens: 256` with `ignore_eos: true`, so every sequence emits exactly 256 tokens. Prompts are sent as plain question text, not rendered through the checkpoint's chat template.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor on a 120-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with built-in draft tokens, 256 concurrent 256-token answers across eight GPUs.
launch:
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
dtype: auto
kv-cache-dtype: auto
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 2048
# A FRACTION DOES NOT PORT ACROSS CARD SIZES. vLLM's startup check demands
# `gpu-memory-utilization * total` FREE before it allocates anything, so on an 80 GB H100 0.9 means
# "71.27 of 79.19 GiB must already be free" -- 7.9 GiB of absolute headroom, against the 29 GiB the
# same fraction leaves on the 288 GB card this setup came from. Measured over 3026 recorded startup
# checks on these nodes, free memory reached 71.27 GiB in 0.5% of them and 55.4 GiB in 31%; while a
# neighbouring process is cycling, the floor sits at 52.4 GiB, so even 0.70 loses that race.
# 0.62 = 49.1 GiB clears the contended floor and is still ~5 GiB above the largest arm's per-rank
# footprint (15.5 weights + 20.3 recurrent state at 256 seqs x 4 slots + 2.1 attention KV + ~6
# workspace/graphs), so nothing about the operating point changes -- only the headroom the check
# wants to see. The engine's own "Maximum concurrency" line confirms it still admits 256.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.62
seed: 0

# The two JSON values below MUST EACH STAY ON ONE LINE: this file is read line by line and indented
# lines are skipped, so written block-style the key parses to nothing and the engine starts without
# it at rc=0 -- for compilation-config that means no capture ladder and a silent eager decode.
speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024], "max_cudagraph_capture_size": 1024}

# kept on so the engine emits its speculative counters
disable-log-stats: false
